rows.note: the pack is 5; one purchase covers it

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: 100 per completed excavator cycle at any level

conditions: Only the plain Resource booster doubles Cryotic; Resource Drop Chance does nothing.
Duviri Circuit pays a trivial amount.
bonuses: A decent group running several excavators reported about 3,000 Cryotic in 30 minutes, the whole bill in one sitting.
A fissure adds a stacking resource bonus plus relics and Forma.
Resourceful Retriever (18%) or Loyal Retriever (13%) on a companion can double a payout.

disclosures.title: other Excavation nodes
disclosures.body: Everest (Earth), Kiliken (Venus), Augustus (Mars), Valefor (Europa) and Despina (Neptune). Harder nodes pay no more per cycle, so pick the one with the best groups. A destroyed excavator still pays in proportion to what it dug.

disclosures.title: keep the excavator alive
disclosures.body: Bring Nekros or another loot frame so cell drops come faster, and avoid soloing it.

bonuses: Polymer also drops on Mercury and Venus; most Uranus resource drops are bundles.

groups.meta: pick this up last, same day as the build
conditions: Argon is halved at 00:00 UTC, rounded down. Collect it the same day you start the build, with every other ingredient already in inventory.
bonuses: Void Fissure survivals while farming relics drop a few passively.

disclosures.title: fast Argon
disclosures.body: A public Hepit game usually has someone range-nuking the map (max-range Xaku, Limbo or Titania); pick up what they break. Without a range frame, a Sentinel with Spare Parts dying in a Void mission was reported to give a couple of crystals per short Capture.

conditions: Mastery Rank 10 to build and equip.
